conventions.convention: The first factor is the subrepresentation: 0 → M_a → M_(a+b) → M_b → 0. Arrow matrices act by g_j X_h g_i^(-1), with upper-right extension blocks Hom(V_i^b,V_j^a).
Intrinsic homology is H_i([X/G]) = H_(i+2 dim G)^(BM,G)(X), using the published supplier's variety-normalized dualizing object. Rank-zero factors are omitted; stabilization is degreewise.
The product has intrinsic homological shift −2χ_Q(b,a), positive complex orientation, and no Euler sign twist, automorphism denominator, Tate enrichment, or completion.

V_f A is restriction of derived sections supported on Re(f) ≤ 0 to f = 0; it equals the normalization φ_f[-1]. Thus V_0 Q = Q and reduced Milnor-fibre H^0 occurs in coefficient degree one. Monodromy uses positive angular continuation.
Standard homological coefficients are K_(d,z) = D_X^G Φ_(d,z)[−2 dim G], with variety-normalized duality and contragredient monodromy D(T^(-1)). All critical values are retained.

Thom–Sebastiani identifies cycles of the restricted extension potential with diagonal coefficients; proper functoriality supplies a coefficient morphism, not an isomorphism to the inverse image of total-space vanishing cycles.

load_bearing.statement: Assuming AC, normalized rational vanishing cycles on smooth separated finite-type complex varieties have bounded constructible constant-input coefficients, smooth commutation, proper commutation on the displayed proper-image inputs, coherent Thom–Sebastiani for the stated standard inputs, normalized duality, and oriented affine-fibration invariance.

Assume AC and use the intrinsic rational Borel–Moore grading. Representation, extension and finite block-flag stacks of every finite complex quiver admit degree-zero representable proper pushforward and smooth block-forgetting pullback of twice the relative stack dimension, with the stated presentation independence, composition, external products, proper/smooth base change and Cartesian pasting.

Assume AC. For every finite quiver and dimension vectors a,b, q is smooth of relative complex stack dimension −χ_Q(b,a), and p is representable proper. Loops, multiple arrows, zero coordinates and the empty quiver are allowed.

Assume AC. For any finite complex quiver and finite potential, the stated normalized vanishing-cycle dual coefficients realize the complete generic coefficient datum, including all critical values and coherent proper/smooth and flag operations; for W = 0 they give precisely the ordinary intrinsic rational Borel–Moore operation package.

Assume AC. For a regular function on a smooth affine complex variety and the stated constructible coefficients, there are cofinal ball/function-tube neighborhoods with proper stratified-submersive closed-ball models over a punctured function neighborhood, controlled coefficient transport, and the stated finite relative cochain models.

concerns.concern: The source report says: “It acts on the Borel–Moore homology of the Lagrangian core of the framed quiver variety and gives an integrable highest-weight representation with highest weight w (Theorem 17 of the review...)”. The cited theorem concerns the direct sum of TOP homology groups H_d(V,W)(L(V,W)), not unqualified full Borel–Moore homology. See Nakajima, https://arxiv.org/pdf/1611.10000v1, §4.5, Theorem 17, printed p. 16; the preceding operator definitions also use those top groups. The distinction is substantive: for the one-vertex no-arrow quiver with framing dimension 2, Example 10 gives L(v,2)=Gr(v,2). Full homology over v=0,1,2 has weight multiplicities 1,2,1 and total dimension 4, whereas the highest-weight-2 sl2 representation has multiplicities 1,1,1 and dimension 3. The source-reported highest-weight assertion needs the top-homology qualification.
